description: This file generates Open Graph images for roadmaps, best practices, and guides by reading markdown data, processing images, and rendering SVGs to PNGs using satori, sharp, and Resvg.

methods.name: generateResourceOpenGraph
methods.description: Generates Open Graph images for roadmaps and best practices, using existing images or creating default templates when images are missing.

methods.name: generateGuideOpenGraph
methods.description: Generates Open Graph images for guides, including author avatars, handling external and internal images.

methods.name: generateOpenGraph
methods.description: Renders SVG to PNG using satori and either sharp or Resvg, saving the image to the filesystem.

methods.name: getRoadmapDefaultTemplate
methods.description: Creates a default SVG template for roadmaps with title and description.

methods.name: getRoadmapImageTemplate
methods.description: Creates an SVG template for roadmaps including an image, title, and description.

methods.name: getGuideTemplate
methods.description: Creates an SVG template for guides including author info, title, and description.

methods.name: unescapeHtml
methods.description: Converts HTML entities back to characters.

methods.name: hasSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Checks if a string contains special characters that need escaping.
